preconditions.expression: N == int(stdin.split()[0]) and N >= 1 and N <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) representing the number of queries.
Each of the N subsequent lines contains exactly two space-separated integers i and j.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(i) <= 10**9 and 1 <= int(j) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:N+1] for i, j in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each query, both integers i and j satisfy 1 ≤ i, j ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly N lines, one for each query.
Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the shortest path length.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[k]) == (lambda i, j: (i ^ j).bit_length() - 1)(*map(int, stdin.splitlines()[k+1].split())) for k in range(N))
postconditions.description: For each query (i, j), the output line is the length of the shortest path between nodes i and j in the infinite full binary tree, computed as the number of bits in the binary representation of (i XOR j) minus one.
